meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让关键计划在敲定前先经受多方挑刺与交叉质疑,变得更扎实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你制定关键计划时希望有人从对立角度帮你查漏补缺,而不是只收获附和。
copy.tagline_en: Toughen up your plan by running it past a hostile review team before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own important plans and want them to survive hostile scrutiny before being locked in.

howto.what: Claude 会进入 Hyperplan 模式,扮演负责人组建 5 名互相敌对的审查专家,让每位专家攻击其他专家的方案;攻击后只把存活下来的可靠见解交给专职规划者,写成正式计划。
howto.when: 当计划需要最大严谨性,或你要求 Hyperplan、对抗性或交叉批评计划时触发。

say.text: 给这份新需求做 Hyperplan 计划
用对抗性交叉批评方式规划这次系统迁移
say.note: 先让五位专家互相攻击,再交给规划者成稿。

say.text: 对我的方案做一次对抗性审查
say.note: 会删掉站不住脚的部分再写正式计划。

howto.what_en: Claude enters Hyperplan mode, acts as the lead of 5 mutually hostile review experts, and has each expert attack the others' proposals. Insights that survive are then handed to a dedicated planner to be turned into a formal plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a plan needs maximum rigor, or when you ask for a Hyperplan, an adversarial, or a cross-critique plan.

say_en.text: Make a Hyperplan for this new requirement.
say_en.note: Claude announces Hyperplan mode and assembles the review team.

say_en.text: Plan this system migration with adversarial cross-critique.
say_en.note: Hostile team review, then a planner writes the plan.

say_en.text: Run an adversarial review of my proposal.
say_en.note: Weak parts get dropped before the plan is written.
